bootstrap.hierarchy: Within every split: mean matched generation seeds per query, mean queries per target, equal target macro. Paired pipeline-minus-each-comparator differences at identical query/seed slots before aggregation. Single target: no CI. No pooling targets across splits.

conditional_metric: Within each attempt having >=1 supplied replay-verified fully evaluated route, matched occurrences / fully evaluated route occurrences. Aggregate observed attempt ratios by query then target, retaining eligibility counts. Null without eligible routes, never fabricate zero; secondary selected-subset descriptive statistic only. Also report pooled occurrence fraction descriptively without occurrence-independent CI.

csv_projection.level: Recorded target-macro summaries plus exact coverage counts; per-query/per-target records remain in analysis.json. No new estimates.
csv_projection.missing_status_count_keys: An absent status-count key is displayed as count zero; missing metric values remain blank.
csv_projection.null_encoding: Blank CSV cell; never replaced by zero
csv_projection.precision: Python round-trip integer/float strings, no decimal rounding

dependence: Occurrences sharing routes or identical reactant/context inputs are reuse, not independent samples; report unique route/input keys and repeated occurrences descriptively. No candidate-, reaction-, route- or seed-level iid uncertainty; cluster at target with query/seed hierarchy. Few-target and cross-target shared-input limitations remain explicit.
interpretation: Product-blind reactant-only input; same model as selection gate so selection-related enrichment is expected. Missing reagents/conditions and absent empirical context remain explicit. No predicted activity, biological validation, experimental synthesis, yield or synthesis probability claim.
limitations: Same forward model as selection gate; agreement is selection-related evidence, not independent experimental validation.
No route supplied is absence of evidence, not a chemical failure. Failed generation slots remain in all-attempt metrics.
Conditional fractions require evaluated routes and report their eligibility; they are not synthesis-success probabilities.
Exact query/seed pairing before target aggregation differs from the original generation target-mean contrasts.
Few target clusters, shared inputs and cross-split dependence limit unadjusted descriptive bootstrap intervals.
Infrastructure identification bounds are not CIs; infrastructure-only complete cases are selection-biased.
Original frozen39 only; current41, supplementary270, and new generation or model inference are excluded.
No activity, yield, experimental synthesis, 3D or pipeline-superiority claim; full training inventories remain unknown.
Existing source attribution preserved; no new license assigned. Historical absolute paths are metadata, not replay input locations.
paired_scope: Exact matching query/seed differences before aggregation; conditional metric requires both observations eligible

parent_integrity_review.scope: Independent direct RDKit route traversal and saved raw-product canonicalization/complete/rank/status interpretation, exact accepted-output joins, terminal lifecycle and retained file hashes. Same RDKit kernel; no model inference or neural prediction reproduction, no activity, yield or empirical synthesis claim. Full statistical reconstruction is a separate gate.

parent_statistics_review.independent_implementation: Pandas dataframe groupby/reindex means and matched query/seed subtraction; integer bootstrap indices and NumPy percentile with frozen seed20261016/10000 draws. Original analyzer not imported or called. Normalized saved outputs originate in separately retained root raw-record/route/prediction audit.
parent_statistics_review.scope: All method and paired query/seed conditional summaries, count/slot/any-route metrics, target bootstrap intervals, infrastructure identification bounds, complete-case secondary availability and shared-input diagnostics. No neural inference, new chemistry, model accuracy or experimental synthesis proof.

plan_design: Post hoc analysis plan specified while all generation and common forward assessment were incomplete; not preregistered confirmatory evidence. No comparative results computed to choose endpoints or subsets.
primary_definition: Indicator: at least one accepted returned candidate supplies a raw route that replays to the exact candidate and has a nonempty set of reaction steps, every common forward prediction status matched and all steps evaluated. All planned attempts remain in denominator; timeout/no_candidates/other terminal failures have no accepted returns.
scope: Byte-preserving parent-reviewed original630 common-forward normalized-record statistical package. Stored CSV projection only; no new model, chemistry, 3D or statistical calculation.
